traits.label: Decisive under pressure
traits.text: Chamberlain orders a bayonet charge up the mountain at night without waiting for ammunition, trusting that the lack of fire would conceal his small force.

citation.doc: Chamberlain's report, July 6, 1863 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 1, scan)
citation.quote: Without waiting to get ammunition, but trusting in part to the very circumstance of not exposing our movement or our small front by firing, and with bayonets fixed

traits.label: Pragmatic resource management
traits.text: He places his men in a strong defensive position among the rocks and immediately requests ammunition and support to secure his exposed right flank.

citation.doc: Chamberlain's report, July 6, 1863 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 1, scan)
citation.quote: I placed the men in a strong position among the rocks, and informed Colonel Rice, requesting also ammunition and some support to our right

traits.label: Protective of subordinates
traits.text: Chamberlain takes personal responsibility for the safety of his wounded by placing them in local houses and later recommends a commutation of sentence for prisoners who fought well.

citation.doc: Chamberlain's report, July 6, 1863 (Official Records, Ser. I, Vol. 27, Part 1, scan)
citation.quote: I had taken the responsibility of putting into the houses of citizens in the vicinity of Little Round Top
